claim_text: England and Macron speaking out and condemning the strikes, seen as the dividing line between sheep and goat nations, with an iron dome of protection called over America.
quote: a dividing who stands and who doesn't
falsify_match: Britain and France taking a formal position against Israel with consequences following.
falsify_miss: Both condemned the strikes within days, which is what he describes, so this reports the diplomatic reaction rather than predicting it.

claim_text: Prayer over the president's towers and hotels and over the window from the 14th through the Fourth of July, on the pattern of the prayer run up to the inauguration, with more attempts to hurt him seen in June and July.
quote: from the 14th all the way up until the 4th of July
falsify_match: An attempt on the president between 14 June and 4 July 2025.
falsify_miss: No attempt in that window. He states in the same passage that nothing happened last time and it will not happen again, which makes the null result the expected one.

claim_text: The protests on the 14th will dwindle to nothing and fall apart with confusion in the enemy's camp, and America will have peace.
quote: all the protest in in on the 14th. They're just going to dwindle to nothing
falsify_match: The 14 June 2025 protests collapsing or failing to materialise.
falsify_miss: The No Kings protests on 14 June 2025 were among the largest single-day demonstrations in American history, with millions participating, which is the opposite of dwindling to nothing. This is a dated, checkable claim.

claim_text: Prayer for Christians and any Americans in Iran and for the secret intelligence people he says he saw inside each place, with healing and deliverance called over them.
quote: I saw secret spies in each one
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: Channel figures given by language: the Japan and Philippines channels struggling, Vietnam taking off, South Korea exploding, and the Hispanic and Portuguese channels growing.
quote: South Korea exploded. It's It's growing huge
falsify_match: Not applicable; an account of the operation.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it records which language channels were working at this date.

claim_text: The Gibson film again with the fifty million figure, and opposition to it seen through its rating, an R certificate keeping believers away, with two versions considered, one more fictional and one more biblical.
quote: I saw the number 50 million to believe God for 50 million
falsify_match: A ratings fight over the film reducing its audience.
falsify_miss: The film is released without a certificate controversy. He says he does not know whether the fifty million is a budget, a surplus or something else, which loosens the figure.

claim_text: A crate in a box car with silver and black lettering, looking like something out of a movie, running north up the railroad tracks between green trees, which he reads as dangerous without being told what it is.
quote: it was in like a crate thing in the in this box car
falsify_match: A rail shipment of dangerous material intercepted heading north.
falsify_miss: Nothing occurs. He supplies the danger reading himself, saying that when he is shown something it is probably not good.

claim_text: A clear glass container with metal ends holding a pathogen from Russia, smuggled into America out of Cuba at night while the grid there is dark, alongside rioting and fires seen in Las Vegas and protests in Dallas, and the 14th given as a date to pray over.
quote: some kind of pathogen in it that was from Russia
falsify_match: A biological agent intercepted entering America from Cuba.
falsify_miss: No such interception. He notes that after he named the 14th, viewers told him rallies were already scheduled that day, which is how the date acquired its content.

claim_text: A white missile with USA on it, triangular, a weapon he has never seen before, and he states plainly that he has seen Israel and America strike Iran, with prayer asked over the American bases in Iraq for the retaliation.
quote: I've seen Israel and America strike Iran
falsify_match: Israel and America both striking Iran after 12 June 2025.
falsify_miss: Neither strikes. Israel struck the next day and America nine days later, so this telling does precede both, though it names no date and Israeli strike preparations were being reported that week.

claim_text: Prayer that the Gibson film have supernatural funding to the fifty million and be made with excellence, becoming the greatest film ever to hit the box office and an Oscar winner.
quote: This will be the greatest movie that's ever hit the box office
falsify_match: The film topping the all-time box office and winning Best Picture.
falsify_miss: It performs like an ordinary religious release. The all-time record stands above two billion dollars, which puts the bar far above anything a fifty million budget would reach.

claim_text: Prayer that China will not have Taiwan and that any plan to take it over falls back on them, with angels camped around Taiwan.
quote: You will not have Taiwan
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition, and it prays against his own Taiwan visions.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. Worth recording because he elsewhere says Taiwan folds in two days, and here prays it will not happen at all.

claim_text: Underground cities under the Smoky Mountains in Tennessee with lights, military and servicemen and Marines inside, which he raises as a question about whether America has such places.
quote: I see underneath the up up underneath the Smokies
falsify_match: Disclosure of a military underground facility under the Smokies.
falsify_miss: No such disclosure. He frames it as a question rather than a statement, and notes nobody would tell you if there were.

claim_text: Iran has made agreements with Russia and with Kim, and if the button is pushed there is retaliation, which he identifies as part of Ezekiel 38 and 39 and the hook in the jaw, adding that he heard the Lord laugh because the outcome is already known.
quote: This I'm seeing it. The hook and the jaw
falsify_match: A Russian and North Korean intervention on Iran's behalf.
falsify_miss: Neither intervened during the June 2025 war. Naming a current event as Ezekiel 38 is a strong identification that can be checked against whether the war widened.

claim_text: Something has been seen that America has now also seen and is about to react to, with Turkey, Pakistan and Afghanistan seen and a rise of anti-semitism.
quote: They're about to react. And a reaction causes a reaction
falsify_match: An American reaction to an undisclosed Iranian capability.
falsify_miss: No such reaction is disclosed. This is the earliest telling of the three named countries, a day before the fuller version.

claim_text: Such a crippling of Iran's infrastructure that it goes dark with no electricity, set back a long way in certain areas, which he suggests may be an EMP or a grid attack while saying to add your own reading.
quote: It's such a crippling of Iran's infrastructure
falsify_match: Iranian national grid failure during the campaign.
falsify_miss: Iranian power stayed largely on through the June 2025 strikes. This is the earliest telling of the crippling, given the day before the Israeli campaign opened.

claim_text: Israel described as a hidden powerhouse and a mighty giant nobody knows about, keeping its cards closed because it could not trust past administrations and barely trusts Trump, with great military might unknown to anyone and something wicked about to be used.
quote: Israel is a hidden powerhouse
falsify_match: An Israeli capability revealed that its allies did not know about.
falsify_miss: Nothing beyond known capabilities appears. This is the earliest telling, given the day before the campaign opened.

claim_text: The tilt of the earth raised for the second time as something changing and being prepared for, alongside Israel with weapons nobody knows of, on the pattern of the pager operation.
quote: the Lord keeps talking about the tilt of the earth
falsify_match: A measurable change in the earth's axial tilt.
falsify_miss: Axial tilt changes by about a degree over forty thousand years, so no perceptible change is possible in this timeframe. He says himself he does not know whether it is a metaphor.

claim_text: He says the word that dark things would be uncovered about the California governor and that his days in office are numbered was recorded a day or two before the Los Angeles riots began, and that others in high positions across America will also be removed.
quote: his days as being governor of California are numbered
falsify_match: The governor leaving office early amid a corruption scandal.
falsify_miss: He serves out his term. The priority question is whether the recording predates the riots; he asserts it does and points to the earlier video.

claim_text: Revivals taking place in celebrities' houses with many celebrities coming to the kingdom, and a great shaking in California, with the fires framed as the beginning of an accelerated seed time and harvest brought on by how the state voted.
quote: there would be revivals taking place in uh celebrities houses
falsify_match: House meetings among well-known figures with public conversions.
falsify_miss: No such meetings. Attributing the fires to how the state voted makes any Californian disaster confirmation.

claim_text: An acceleration of seed time and harvest, so that consequences arrive quickly, given as the explanation for the fires and disorder in places that vote a particular way, with more of the same coming.
quote: this is a seed time and harvest of acceleration
falsify_match: Disasters concentrating in Democratic-voting states beyond their exposure.
falsify_miss: Disasters fall where hazard and population put them. This is the earliest telling of the acceleration on file, two days before the 13 June version.

claim_text: Revival breaking out in high schools and grade schools as well as college campuses around the world, and prayer groups and the glory falling in Las Vegas casinos while people are still at the slot machines.
quote: I saw it happening in casinos in Las Vegas
falsify_match: Documented revival meetings inside Las Vegas casinos and a school prayer movement at scale.
falsify_miss: Neither occurs. Casinos are the specific and unusual part; school prayer movements recur and would be harder to distinguish.

claim_text: A weapon going out of Russia and striking on the border near Warsaw, making a huge blast zone that goes straight up like a mushroom cloud, which he is told is not a nuclear weapon but something never used on the planet before, and he takes a Kim Clement word as confirmation.
quote: this is a weapon, Brennan, that you've never seen before
falsify_match: A novel Russian weapon used against Poland near Warsaw.
falsify_miss: No such strike. The not-a-nuke qualification means any large explosion could be fitted, and the confirmation comes from another prophet's recording rather than an event.

claim_text: He plays a Kim Clement recording in which Clement describes a weapon in a human mind and alphabetical letters he saw.
quote: This weapon is in a human mind
falsify_match: Not applicable; this is another person's recording being played.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. A clip he plays is not a claim he makes, and is recorded here only to show what he treats as confirmation.

claim_text: The Clement recording continues with ashes and a charmer, a serpent in a man with seducing power, rising out of the ashes, and an instruction to keep an eye on Russia, after which he adds that when a general dies mid-battle the baton passes to another.
quote: out of the ashes arose a charmer, a man, a serpent
falsify_match: Not applicable; another person's words.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. He uses it to position himself as taking up Clement's assignment, which is worth recording.

claim_text: Bad people who crossed the border over four years are now acting in California, with ten major cities named to watch: Los Angeles, Dallas, Phoenix, Denver, Chicago, New York, Atlanta, Miami and Las Vegas, and martial law possibly coming.
quote: 10 major cities and watch Las Vegas
falsify_match: Coordinated foreign-organised violence across several of the named cities.
falsify_miss: No coordinated action. The list changes between tellings, which is worth noting: Denver and Las Vegas appear here but not in the 22 June ten.

claim_text: A wave taller than the Space Needle at its base coming into Seattle and destroying it, with an earthquake and a major volcano off the Oregon coastline, and waves beyond anything America has seen.
quote: a major wave that was taller than the Space Needle
falsify_match: A tsunami over 180 metres striking Seattle.
falsify_miss: No such wave. Seattle sits on Puget Sound behind the Olympic Peninsula, which shelters it from open-ocean tsunami; the Space Needle is 184 metres, far above any recorded wave except the 1958 Lituya Bay run-up.

claim_text: Prayer that the film be seen in Australia, Europe, the Middle East and Asia and be the biggest grossing box office film in history, showing that people want godly films, and that it not be a letdown.
quote: the biggest grossing box office blockbuster ever in the history
falsify_match: The film reaching the top of the all-time box office.
falsify_miss: It does not. He adds a hedge asking that it not be a big letdown, which acknowledges the possibility inside the prayer.

claim_text: The fifty million figure repeated in the moment as a five and a zero seen, with the room agreeing they have hit on it.
quote: I see $50 million. I see the number five Z
falsify_match: A budget or gross of fifty million for the film.
falsify_miss: A figure far from fifty million. The number is confirmed inside the prayer session rather than independently.

claim_text: Strategic cities seen with Antifa rioting and planned disruptions: Chicago, Dallas, Seattle, Baltimore, Miami, Washington DC and Kansas City, tied to the immigration enforcement protests, with the 14th seen again.
quote: More planned uh disruptions across America
falsify_match: Protests in most of the named cities on 14 June 2025.
falsify_miss: The No Kings protests on 14 June covered roughly two thousand locations including all of these, so the named list is satisfied by an event that was already publicly scheduled when he spoke.

claim_text: Denver added, with people trying to copy the Los Angeles uprising in other cities, described as evil men plotting to stir up strife.
quote: trying to do LA again, trying to uprise in other cities
falsify_match: Riots in Denver on the Los Angeles pattern.
falsify_miss: Protests stay peaceful. Copycat spread was already the expectation being discussed in the news that week.

claim_text: Multiple protests going on at once throughout America like a civil unrest, with martial law coming to some places.
quote: martial laws coming to some places
falsify_match: Martial law declared in any American city.
falsify_miss: National Guard deployment happened in Los Angeles but martial law was not declared anywhere. The distinction between the two is the whole claim.

claim_text: Prayer over the big Macy's fireworks show in New York and over Washington for the Fourth of July, that the crowds not be in harm's way and the celebration go without a hitch.
quote: the the big fireworks show in New York
falsify_match: An incident at the Macy's fireworks or the Washington celebration on 4 July 2025.
falsify_miss: Both passed without incident. Naming a specific event and date makes this checkable, though as a petition the null result reads as answered prayer.

claim_text: A reception prepared for the bride with white china, forks and chopsticks laid because not everyone uses a fork, lace and twinkling lights powered by the Holy Spirit strung through huge oak trees like weeping willows.
quote: there was a reception that he was preparing for the for the bride
falsify_match: Not checkable in this life by design.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. Recorded because the chopsticks detail is the kind of specificity that shows how the visions are furnished.

claim_text: Houses in heaven sized to what people believed for, including a massive cobblestone castle on a hill above the golden street that someone had believed for, used to argue for stretching your faith beyond a hundred dollars.
quote: Somebody was believing for a massive castle and they got it
falsify_match: Not checkable by design.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. It functions as a giving appeal, which is why it sits next to the hundred dollar faith teaching.

claim_text: Prayer that Putin and Zelensky be bridled with no long range missiles, no nuclear war and no deaths in the tens of thousands, with the church named as the restrainer whose removal starts the tribulation.
quote: We are the great restrainer
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though the restrainer doctrine here means the tribulation cannot begin while the church is present, which constrains his other timelines.

claim_text: Revival called over Asia, the Middle East, South America, Australia and Mexico, and over Israel with a supernatural move through Jerusalem including manifestations at the Western Wall.
quote: great demonstrations and manifestations even at the whailing wall
falsify_match: Public Christian manifestations at the Western Wall.
falsify_miss: None occur. The Western Wall is under rabbinic authority where Christian display is prohibited, which makes this the least likely place he names.

claim_text: A major harvest called over Israel, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Jordan, Syria, Iraq, Iran, Afghanistan, Egypt, Africa, Europe, Russia and Canada.
quote: there will be a major harvest of souls all throughout Israel
falsify_match: Conversion movements across the named states.
falsify_miss: No such movements. Naming essentially every country removes any place where absence could count.

claim_text: Such a surplus on the remnant who listen about their finances that there is no room to receive it and no lack among anybody, enough to pay for churches, food and water for the end time harvest, on the Acts pattern.
quote: There will be such a surplus and such a ble blessing
falsify_match: An identifiable transfer of wealth into churches funding the harvest.
falsify_miss: No such transfer. The condition of listening about finances means any absence can be attributed to not having listened.

claim_text: The glory in Californian schools instead of the liberal thinking, and the California governor's days numbered in his position, with great corruption to be uncovered and a stench before God.
quote: His days are numbered in his position
falsify_match: The governor removed from office early.
falsify_miss: He completes his term, which ends in January 2027 by term limits in any case, so leaving office is guaranteed and only early removal would count.

claim_text: The Ezekiel 38 and 39 war about to happen very soon with Gog and Magog identified as Russia, Turkey, Iran and Syria, and North Korean men shipped by train to Ukraine escalating it into a third world war.
quote: Ezekiel 38 and39 war is about to happen very soon
falsify_match: A coalition war on Israel involving those states.
falsify_miss: No such war. North Korean troop deployments to Russia had been publicly reported since October 2024, so that leg describes an existing fact.

claim_text: North Korean farmers with no training shipped to fight and slaughtered on the battlefield, with NATO and the UK coming together to defeat Putin because they need a boogeyman and war stimulates the economy, and Macron coming across as a Hitler and becoming a major mouthpiece.
quote: I saw farmers, men that were not trained to fight
falsify_match: Heavy North Korean casualties among untrained conscripts in Ukraine.
falsify_miss: They perform as regular troops. Heavy North Korean losses in Kursk had already been reported by January 2025, five months before this.

claim_text: From material he says he never released publicly: watch Cuba and Russia in Cuba on the Cuban missile crisis pattern, and a red dawn experience coming, an enemy within and a Trojan horse that is an act of war rather than terrorism, infiltrated over the last four years.
quote: A red dawn experience is coming
falsify_match: An organised armed action inside America traced to a foreign state.
falsify_miss: No such action. He cites private archives as the source, which means the earlier word cannot be checked against a public record.

claim_text: The rat he was shown is identified as Musk, sneaky and not a true friend, with things tying him to Russia that he says he cannot go into for his own safety, and an ulterior motive behind the donations that turns into a knife in the back when unmet.
quote: I saw things that were tied to him to Russia
falsify_match: Documented Musk ties to Russia beyond ordinary business contact.
falsify_miss: No such ties established. The identification is made the day after the public falling out, which is what the passage is reacting to.

claim_text: Politicians with secret bank accounts and dark things with big money concerning Ukraine to be uncovered, which he says is deeper and darker than the JFK files, with monsters inside Congress.
quote: I saw politicians with secret bank accounts
falsify_match: Hidden accounts exposed for sitting members of Congress tied to Ukraine funding.
falsify_miss: No such exposure. Congressional financial disclosure already exists, so hidden accounts would have to be off the record entirely.

claim_text: An exposing of things coming in which people's pasts come back on them, the powerful who thought money made them untouchable hanged by their own rope, and a shaking in politics.
quote: the devil hangs you with your own rope
falsify_match: A run of scandals bringing down senior political figures.
falsify_miss: Political scandals stay at their usual rate. Exposure of the powerful is predicted continuously in this genre and costs nothing to say.
